title: Coherent right-adjoint Ind construction at a regular cardinal
statement: Use the universes, coherent infinity categories, spaces and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the filtered completion and compactness conventions of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category] and [lem-coef-ind-kappa-presentability], and mapping-space adjunctions of [lem-coef-presentable-infinity-adjoints]. Fix an infinite regular cardinal $\lambda$ in the smaller universe. Let $\operatorname{Cat}^{\mathrm{rex}(\lambda)}_\infty$ be the infinity category whose objects are small infinity categories admitting all $\lambda$-small colimits and whose morphisms preserve those colimits. For every such $C$, let $\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(C)$ be the full subcategory of $\operatorname{Fun}(C^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$ spanned by small $\lambda$-filtered colimits of representables. Write $j_C:C\to\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(C)$ for its Yoneda embedding. If $u:C\to D$ is a morphism in $\operatorname{Cat}^{\mathrm{rex}(\lambda)}_\infty$, write $j_D:D\to\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(D)$ for the target Yoneda embedding and let $L_u:\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(C)\to\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(D)$ be the essentially unique extension of $j_Du$ along $j_C$ preserving small $\lambda$-filtered colimits. Then $L_u$ has a right adjoint $u^*:\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(D)\to\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(C)$ preserving small $\lambda$-filtered colimits. The assignments $C\mapsto\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(C)$ and $u\mapsto u^*$ form a coherent contravariant functor $\operatorname{Cat}^{\mathrm{rex}(\lambda),\mathrm{op}}_\infty\to\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$, including all higher simplices.
